name: Level 27: Virtual Memory Paging & TLB
description: Virtual Memory Unit! RAM 0..3 stores the Page Table: Page 0->Frame 10, Page 1->Frame 20, Page 2->Frame 30, Page 3->Frame 40. Read Virtual Page numbers [0, 1, 2, 3] from Inbox (0,1), look up Physical Frame Address in Page Table, and output to Outbox (4,1)!
